shopkart_refund.source: shopkart.example/refund-policy (fixture - swap for live Olostep fetch)
shopkart_refund.text: ShopKart refund policy: undelivered orders are refunded in full if claimed within 14 days of the last promised delivery date. Claims go to refunds@shopkart.example with the order id. Refund reaches the original payment method in 5-7 business days.
